encoding.color_means: blue = detection (heading, task boxes, block arrows, the word Detecting); orange = grounding and manipulated content (heading, output boxes, outlines on the edited face and phrase, curved arrows); green = real or original (Real, ticks, frames of the originals, central panel); red = the values the task flags or outputs (Fake, crosses, edited tokens, coordinates)
encoding.line_style_means: fat blue arrows = from the input pair to the detection tasks; orange curves = from the edited crop or phrase to the grounding outputs; straight orange lines with a dot = from the marked region to its enlarged crop; thin black arrows = original becomes manipulated; black dashed vertical lines = column dividers
encoding.shape_means: rounded boxes = task or output cards; the big green rounded panel = the input record; framed squares = face crops; the fat left-pointing arrows = which input a task reads
encoding.marker_means: tick and cross mark which manipulation types apply (here FS and TA ticked, matching the swapped face and the rewritten phrase); green frame = original, orange frame = manipulated; the dot on a box or phrase starts a leader line
encoding.emphasis: The title tab splits the task name into blue 'Detecting' and orange 'Grounding', matching the two side columns; orange outlines on the face and the phrase pull the eye to the manipulated parts.

lessons.what_to_learn: Define a new task with one annotated example: put the input record in the middle, send the questions (detection) to one side and the answers to be located (grounding) to the other, and give each side one colour that also colours the title words, headings, boxes and arrows.

attempts to detect more fine-grained manipulation types and ground manipulated image bboxes and text tokens
FS: Face Swap Manipulation, FA: Face Attribute Manipulation, TS: Text Swap Manipulation, TA: Text Attribute Manipulation

summary: The paper defines a new task, Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation (DGM4): for an image-text pair, say whether it is real or fake, which manipulation types occurred, and where the edits are. Figure 1 draws one manipulated news item in a green panel at the centre: a photo with an orange box on a swapped face and a caption with the rewritten phrase 'is forced to resign' highlighted, plus a Manipulation panel that pairs each original crop or phrase with its edited version. Fat blue arrows lead left to four detection boxes (Real or Fake ? three times, and ticks and crosses for FS, FA, TS, TA); orange curved arrows lead right to the grounding outputs, box coordinates and tokens. Blue and orange colour the two sides throughout.
summary_zh: 论文提出新任务 DGM4：对图文对判断真假、操纵类型，并定位被篡改的图像框和文字词。图中央用一条被篡改的新闻（换脸照片加改写的句子）做示例，蓝色箭头指向左侧四个检测问题，橙色箭头指向右侧的框坐标和词。
notes: Prior kinds kept (scope-overview, worked-walkthrough). No model is drawn: HAMMER, the paper's model, does not appear in this figure. The three zones are treated as columns (lanes) of one drawing, not as panels, because arrows join them and one title covers the whole; the prior's panels=3 is not followed. The tick and cross reading (FS and TA ticked, FA and TS crossed) is inferred from the example shown. The warning-triangle and magnifier icons are 11 pt bitmaps.
